purpose: Teach: 書き込ま/予告編/エンターテインメント/ニックネーム/イコール/号機/点灯/アース
target_vocab: エンターテインメント

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 議事録にしっかりと書き込まないとね
lines.en: We need to make sure to write that down carefully in the minutes.
lines.style: Purposeful, measured pace. Slight emphasis on 「しっかり」 — not rushing, setting a standard. Warm but professional. The tone of someone who knows details matter.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品の予告編をSNSで公開します
lines.en: Yes. We'll be releasing a teaser for the new product on social media.
lines.style: Earnest and responsive. Clear articulation on the action items. Not performing — just laying out what he'll do. Steady eye contact level through the sentence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: エンターテインメント業界との連携を進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with building connections in the entertainment industry.
lines.style: Gentle authority. Opening with quiet conviction. Collaborative — inviting rather than commanding. Slight lean-in on 「進めましょう」, like drawing him into the plan.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員のニックネーム制度を整理します
lines.en: Understood. I'll clean up the employee nickname system.
lines.style: Affirming without hesitation. Direct, efficient delivery. No elaboration — just confirming the next task. Professional tempo, slightly brisk.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 忙しさと業績はイコールではないですね
lines.en: Being busy and performing well aren't the same thing, are they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower pace. Opens softly — the thought is arriving as she speaks. Quiet reflection, not judgment. Trailing off slightly, inviting him to think with her rather than agree.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製造ラインの五号機を停止します
lines.en: Right. I'll request the electrical work on the distribution panel.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Straightforward, no embellishment. The tone of someone wrapping up. Clear and professional, wrapping the task into his mental list.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ショーケースの点灯確認を毎朝しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure to check the display case lights every morning.
lines.style: Clear, directed instruction. Steady pace, not rushed. Practical and kind — she's setting up a system that helps. Ends with quiet certainty, like she's already seeing it happen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。配電盤のアース工事を依頼します
lines.en: Yes. I'll arrange the grounding work on the electrical panel.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Clear and complete. The slight finality of the last confirmation — not abrupt, but settling into what's been covered. Professional and certain.
